description.pl: Makieta frontendu sklepu internetowego. Wyświetlanie produktów, filtrowanie po kategoriach, wyszukiwanie, koszyk z zapisem w localStorage.
description.en: An e-commerce frontend mockup. Product display, category filtering, search, shopping cart with localStorage persistence.

longDescription.en:
the project 🇬🇧
An e-commerce frontend mockup created as a portfolio project. The application demonstrates the ability to create user interfaces using Vue 3 (Composition API) and manage state without external libraries like Vuex or Pinia....
